requirements: Atomically reserve exact device UUIDs on every participating host under existing admission locks before starting isolated Ray nodes

Expose only each node own leased GPU mask; unset driver CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES so NeMo does not broadcast the head mask to other nodes
Use explicit owned RAY_ADDRESS plus the common worker interpreter alias verified in the CPU probe
Use identical shared model/data/native-checkpoint paths and preserve initial fresh optimizer then native half-to-full optimizer resume
Keep spare CPU resources for environment builders/initializer actors
Before admission require bounded exact GPU UUID/rank mapping and NCCL transport receipts; a small transport check is not an eight-rank model-memory validation

decision: No multi-host scientific admission: insufficient eligible capacity and GPU route unverified. Preserve current single-host waiting controller and all healthy 8B children.

admission_implementation_notes.preserve_existing_controller: Canonical remote_E_14b record remains adoptable by the healthy waiting controller.

admission_implementation_notes.driver_address: Explicit owned GCS address overrides local; retain immutable wrapper and exact scientific YAML.
admission_implementation_notes.next_acceptance: Exactly eight eligible UUIDs, private Ray/NeMo binding and GPU communication proof, then first native frozen update with matching tokens.
